parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
The first electron affinity of an atom is usually an exothermic process, whereas the second electron affinity is an endothermic process.

Suggest why.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: Describe the general trend in first electron affinities for $\text{Cl}$, $\text{Br}$ and $\text{I}$. Explain your answer.
